upstream.note: Clamor exposes this block as a read-only plan and is private to public CI. This record pins the inspected definition; CI verifies the adapted local materialization against this record and does not claim to query Clamor.

digestVerification.method: The upstream BlockDefinition was loaded at the pinned commit and definitionRef() was computed with Clamor's canonical kernel digest before materialization.

adaptations.rationale: Migration 0010 preserves the upstream Commitlint invocation while replacing the Bash wrapper with an executable Bun TypeScript hook.
Design spec 0005 requires every commit and PR title to conform; merge, nonconventional revert, and version messages cannot use Commitlint's default exemptions.

GitHub forms a squash body from the feature report after the protected PR gates run. Conventional Commit identity is carried by the validated squash title, so prose line wrapping must not create a post-merge-only rejection.
Migration 0010 preserves exact staged-file formatting and linting, then invokes the Bun fast-loop entrypoint without a Bash runtime.
The project-owned Bun hook clears Git hook-local repository variables before invoking the pinned Nix integration gate; this path is absent from the upstream block.
The project installer preserves an existing custom local core.hooksPath and fails closed when Git cannot apply the .githooks configuration.

deviationsFromBlock: commitlint.config.ts and the commit-msg/pre-commit hooks begin from upstream renders but are intentionally adapted to the Bun runtime and hardened as recorded, so they are not claimed byte-identical to Clamor.
.githooks/pre-push is a project-owned Bun lifecycle hook, not an upstream block claim.

scripts/install-git-hooks.ts is intentionally hardened to preserve custom local hook configuration and fail closed when Git cannot apply the project path, so it is not claimed byte-identical to Clamor.
The package also pins Bun, Oxfmt, Oxlint, and stable TypeScript 7 for this repository; those choices are outside the upstream block's claim set.

conformance.method: Checks immutable upstream identity fields, exact configured inputs, required adaptation records, content digests, semantic package keys, and executable modes. It verifies local conformance to this checked record without claiming a live private-upstream query.
